log.text: Toxic Spikes up on P1's side

decisions.rationale: Dragapult + Incineroar lead: Dragapult outspeeds everything (198 Spe > Noivern 192 max), Dragon Darts 2HKOs most. Incineroar Fake Out breaks sashes/disrupts, Intimidate cripples Excadrill/Absol. Kingambit back: Supreme Overlord Sucker Punch cleans late vs Noivern/Scizor. Appletun back: Thick Fat walls Rotom-Wash/Toxapex, Apple Acid 2HKOs Rotom-Wash through Wacan Berry. No Fairy types on opponent — Dragon STAB unresisted.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead: Dragapult (198 Spe fastest) + Incineroar (Intimidate cycle). Kingambit and Appletun in back. Appletun handles Rotom-Wash/Toxapex; Kingambit Sucker Punch cleans fast threats. Watch for Absol Focus Sash + Sucker Punch, Scizor Bullet Punch, Excadrill Mold Breaker bypassing Thick Fat. Noivern only speed threat but outsped by Dragapult.

decisions.rationale: Toxapex leads to set Toxic Spikes and wall Dragapult/physical attackers with Regenerator sustain. Rotom-Wash follows as a Levitate pivot that covers Grass/Electric threats and enables Volt Switch momentum. Noivern and Excadrill are held back to protect them; Noivern's 192 Speed and Draco Meteor threaten Dragapult, while Excadrill's Mold Breaker Earthquake and Stealth Rock provide late-game pressure.
decisions.notebook: Opponent runs Parting Shot pivot strategy. Toxapex + Rotom-Wash form defensive backbone. Scizor Technician Bullet Punch 2x super-effective on Mega Gardevoir (Steel vs Fairy) and can OHKO. Absol Knock Off strips Gardevoirite; Sucker Punch priority revenge. Noivern outspeeds field at 192 Speed, Defog for hazard control. Excadrill Mold Breaker Earthquake hits Incineroar/Kingambit without hurting Rotom-Wash. Watch for Dragapult speed tier (178-213).

decisions.rationale: Fake Out Rotom-Wash prevents Will-O-Wisp burn on Dragapult. Dragon Darts into Toxapex is unblockable in doubles: if Toxapex BanefulBunkers, both hits land on Rotom (51-96%); otherwise spreads chip to both foes. This scouts their protect habits while preserving Dragapult's offensive integrity.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead Dragapult+Incineroar vs Toxapex+Rotom-W. Opponent back 2 of {Excadrill,Noivern,Scizor,Absol}. Key threats: Will-O-Wisp on physical Dragapult, Mold Breaker EQ bypassing Thick Fat, Focus Sash Absol Sucker Punch. Kingambit+Appletun in back; Appletun walls Rotom-W/Toxapex, Kingambit Sucker Punch cleans fast frailer threats. Incineroar Intimidate already applied. Plan: pivot Incineroar via Parting Shot later to re-Intimidate.

decisions.rationale: Toxic Spikes pressures both foes on entry and pairs well with our defensive backbone. Shadow Ball on Dragapult exploits the 2x super-effective STAB hit to dent the fastest threat before it can act.

Toxic Spikes set on both foes this turn; next turn look to pivot with Volt Switch or bring in Excadrill/Noivern for offensive pressure.

decisions.rationale: Dragon Darts chips both foes; if one protects, both hits concentrate on the other (51-96% to Rotom, 37-69% to Toxapex). Dragapult outspeeds and attacks before Will-O-Wisp. Parting Shot into Toxapex safely pivots Incineroar to Kingambit, who is Steel-immune to our Toxic Spikes. Toxapex lacks attacks and can't escape the Parting Shot except via Baneful Bunker, which still lets Dragon Darts double into Rotom.

Key threats: Will-O-Wisp on physical Dragapult, Mold Breaker EQ bypassing Thick Fat, Focus Sash Absol Sucker Punch. Appletun walls Rotom-W/Toxapex but is poisoned by TSpikes on switch. Kingambit immune to TSpikes, provides Sucker Punch pressure. Incineroar Intimidate already used; plan to Parting Shot pivot later for re-Intimidate. Rotom-W has Wacan Berry (Electric resist). Toxapex moves: BanefulBunker/Recover/Haze/ToxicSpikes (no attacks).

decisions.rationale: Baneful Bunker protects Toxapex from incoming attacks and poisons contact users (Dragon Darts, FlareBlitz, Parting Shot). Shadow Ball hits Dragapult for 2x effectiveness, applying heavy pressure on its 90% HP while Toxapex stays safe to regenerate next turn.

Incineroar Parting Shot into Toxapex adds a second layer of offensive debuff (-2 Atk/-1 SpA total) and pivots to Kingambit, who is immune to Toxic Spikes. Noivern never gets to act, and the opponent is forced into Toxapex + last unrevealed mon with a crippled Toxapex.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Turn 3 plan — Dragapult Dragon Darts KOs Noivern before it acts. Incineroar Parting Shot debuffs Toxapex further and switches to Kingambit (TSpikes immune). Opponent's last unrevealed is one of {Excadrill,Scizor,Absol}. After turn 3, we have Dragapult+Kingambit vs Toxapex (heavily debuffed)+last mon. Kingambit's Supreme Overlord currently at 1 KO boost (Rotom-W). Appletun available but TSpikes-poisoned on entry; keep for cleanup.

decisions.rationale: Dragapult stays in to KO Noivern with Dragon Darts next turn (guaranteed faster). Incineroar switches to Kingambit, which is immune to our own Toxic Spikes and brings Supreme Overlord boosted by Rotom-W's KO. Appletun would be poisoned on entry.

Appletun best saved for cleanup if needed.

decisions.rationale: Noivern's Draco Meteor OHKOs Dragapult (148-211%) at 2x super-effectiveness, eliminating the opponent's fastest threat. Toxapex uses Recover to stay healthy as the defensive backbone. Incineroar's likely Parting Shot mainly lowers offenses irrelevant to Bold Toxapex.

decisions.rationale: Dragapult Dragon Darts OHKOs Noivern (16% HP) before it can move, removing its SE Draco Meteor threat. Kingambit Kowtow Cleave pressures Toxapex for 34-60% — non-contact Iron Head does only 13-24% and Sucker Punch on Noivern would be redundant if Dragapult KOs. Baneful Bunker is a risk but Toxapex last used Recover, so it's reset; opponent may Haze or attack instead. Even if Toxapex bunkers, Noivern falls and we stay 2v2 with a strong board.

decisions.rationale: Noivern at 17% must switch out to avoid being KOed by Dragapult's super-effective Dragon moves. Baneful Bunker protects Toxapex from Dragon Darts, poisons fast physical attacker Dragapult (wearing down Life Orb + speed tier), and preserves Toxapex's health. Excadrill pivoting in threatens Kingambit with Mold Breaker Earthquake (Steel now takes neutral Ground) and pressures Incineroar, while Dragapult's poison saps its longevity.

decisions.rationale: Dragapult Protects to survive Iron Head (59.5-84.7% into 61% HP). Kingambit Kowtow Cleaves Excadrill for 48.8-94.6%; combined with Excadrill's 52% HP, a high roll KOs. If Excadrill Earthquakes, Toxapex takes 49.7-106.4% from its own ally. Toxapex's Baneful Bunker has reduced success. Safe pressure that preserves both mons for next turn cleanup.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent's last unrevealed is one of {Excadrill,Scizor,Absol} — now revealed as Excadrill. Kingambit's Supreme Overlord currently at 1 KO (Rotom-W). Toxic Spikes on our side. Dragapult outspeeds Noivern (198 vs 157-192). Excadrill is Ground/Steel with Mold Breaker + Life Orb; its Earthquake hits our entire team hard. Incineroar's Intimidate can neuter Excadrill in a pinch. Appletun has Thick Fat for Ice resist but is slow. Noivern at 16% is nearly dead and should be cleaned up when convenient.

selection: Baneful Bunker [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Baneful Bunker protects Excadrill from Dragapult's Draco Meteor and may poison contact users; Earthquake hits both foes for heavy damage (2x vs Kingambit). Even with reduced success, Toxapex at 100% survives self-Earthquake at ~46%. This maximizes immediate damage while shielding Excadrill.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Dragapult outspeeds Noivern and Dragon Darts is a guaranteed OHKO (100-188%). Kingambit Kowtow Cleave chips Toxapex for 34-60% while it may Recover or Haze. Noivern never moves. After this turn it's 2v1 vs Toxapex alone — a won endgame regardless of what Toxapex does.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent down to Toxapex + Noivern (both benches fainted). Dragapult always outspeeds Noivern (198 vs 157-192). Dragon Darts guaranteed OHKO on Noivern. After Noivern falls, clean 2v1 cleanup vs Toxapex. Supreme Overlord at 1 KO currently. Toxic Spikes remain on our side — keep Appletun in mind if we need a switch later.

decisions.rationale: Toxapex at 45% HP needs Recover to stay healthy as the team's defensive backbone. Noivern at 17% should fire Draco Meteor at Dragapult for 2x super-effective damage before potentially being KO'd; Dragapult's Protect success is reduced, improving hit chances.

reflections.summary: The win was primarily due to Noivern's missed Draco Meteor on turn 3, which kept Dragapult healthy enough to continue pressuring, coupled with the early elimination of Rotom-Wash via Fake Out + Dragon Darts that created a numerical advantage.
reflections.adjustment: In game 2, if the opponent leads similarly, use Incineroar's Fake Out on Noivern to prevent Draco Meteor, while Dragapult targets Rotom-Wash with Dragon Darts to replicate the early KO. If they lead differently, prioritize protecting Dragapult from status (e.g., Will-O-Wisp) and chip damage to preserve its ability to outpace and OHKO Noivern.
reflections.notebook: Opponent revealed items: Toxapex Leftovers, Excadrill Life Orb, Noivern WiseGlasses, Rotom-Wash Wacan Berry. Key moves: Toxapex—Baneful Bunker, Recover, Haze, Toxic Spikes; Excadrill—Earthquake, Iron Head, Rock Slide, Stealth Rock; Noivern—Boomburst, Draco Meteor, Hurricane, Defog; Rotom-Wash—Shadow Ball, Volt Switch, Will-O-Wisp, Protect. Toxic Spikes persists on our side, limiting safe switch-ins for grounded non-Poison types (Incineroar, Appletun). Kingambit is immune and Dragapult can operate with Life Orb recoil. Noivern's Draco Meteor is a major threat to Dragapult, but Dragapult's speed ensures a clean OHKO if it attacks first. Opponent may adapt by preserving Noivern or using Excadrill more aggressively. Watch for Will-O-Wisp crippling our physical attackers. Supreme Overlord gains value with KOs—stacking it early could be beneficial.

reflections.summary: Lost because the team had no safe answer to the Dragapult + Kingambit offensive duo. Noivern was dead weight — OHKO'd by Dragon Darts both times it entered and contributed zero meaningful damage (Draco Meteor missed). After Excadrill's Earthquake weakened Kingambit to 23%, it was revenge-killed by Kowtow Cleave with no follow-up. The opponent's Parting Shot pivot (Dragapult/Incineroar) kept bringing Kingambit in safely, and once Excadrill and Toxapex fell, nothing remaining could threaten the opponent's core.
reflections.adjustment: Replace Noivern with a Pokémon that can safely switch into Dragon Darts and threaten Kingambit — a bulky Dragon-resist with priority or strong neutral offense (e.g., a Meowscarada or Garganacl). Alternatively, bring a dedicated Kingambit check that can absorb Kowtow Cleave and retaliate. Do not rely on a fast but frail special attacker that folds to a single neutral hit.
reflections.notebook: Opponent Parting Shot pivot core confirmed again: Dragapult/Incineroar. Kingambit is the primary closer — Supreme Overlord stacks + Kowtow Cleave threaten any neutral target; must have a dedicated check. Dragapult double-hit Dragon Darts punishes Water/ground switch-ins hard. Excadrill Mold Breaker Earthquake is the best tool vs Kingambit/Incineroar but needs a safe entry (not after taking prior damage). Toxic Spikes on opponent side; second layer means bad poison on future switch-ins. Noivern inadequate vs this opponent — folds to Dragon Darts and Draco Meteor unreliable; replace in next game's team pick. One opponent slot still unrevealed from Appletun/Serperior/Talonflame — prepare for Grass or Fire coverage. Foe Kingambit left at 23% was not converted to a KO; need reliable finishing power or secure the KO before it resets.
